build.buildCommand: node scripts/prisma-postgres.mjs && DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://build:build@127.0.0.1:5432/build} npx prisma generate && next build

deploy.startCommand: node scripts/prisma-postgres.mjs && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts && next start --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8080}
